newsitem.title: USA: Washington Centralia coal unit seen down through Friday.
newsitem.headline: Washington Centralia coal unit seen down through Friday.

text.p: One of the two 670-megawatt units at the Centralia coal-fired power plant in southwest Washington state tripped off-line Thursday and is expected to return to service late Friday night, said PacifiCorp, the plant's operator.
The unit was removed from operation at 0900 PDT due to a boiler tube leak, said a company source.
Centralia's other 670-MW unit continues to operate at full load, he added.
